provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: readPath's root branch verifies object existence; a final field returns its slot without dereferencing its target, while a longer suffix requires an occupied intermediate slot and recurring object lookup. The revised wording now says the final identity is not dereferenced, distinguishing this operation from the later Satisfies liveness condition.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Proof correctness is checked separately by Lean; the correspondence review compares statements, definitions and example propositions.
Abstract syntax and mathematical GC are modeled; no parser or executable collector is certified. Functions safety permits divergence.
